name: @tanishqkancharla/diffmap
description: Serve a spec or code walkthrough as a local page
author: Tanishq Kancharla

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src vite.config.ts vite.gist.config.ts vite.viewer.config.ts bin.js
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src vite.config.ts vite.gist.config.ts vite.viewer.config.ts bin.js
scripts.prepack: npm run build:viewer && npm run build:lib
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.pretest: npm run build:viewer && npm run build:lib
scripts.test: tsx --test src/cli.test.ts src/update.test.ts src/parseViewer.test.ts src/git.test.ts src/serve.test.ts src/gist/route.test.ts src/github/route.test.ts src/github/patch.test.ts src/github/fetchRepo.test.ts src/viewer/sourceHeader.test.ts src/viewer/comments.test.ts src/host/home.test.ts
scripts.build:lib: node -e "fs.rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
